# Jotform

Jotform is an online form builder that allows users to create and manage forms for various purposes, including data collection, surveys, and more.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/jotform/.

## Actions

- **Get System Plan**: Retrieve details of a specific system plan.
- **Get User Details**: Retrieve details of the authenticated user, including account and usage info.
- **Get User Folders**: Retrieve a list of folders created by the authenticated user.
- **Get User Forms**: Retrieve a list of forms created by the authenticated user.
- **Get User History**: Fetch user activity history records.
- **Get User Settings**: Retrieve the settings of the authenticated user.
